admin_status_legend_ws_html: Active WebSocket connection in the gateway's memory. Each tab open in the app counts as a tab (the "Tabs" column). After a forced stop of the app, the server sends a Ping every 30s: if it doesn't receive a Pong, it closes the connection. The user stays marked "WS connected" for up to ~30s after disconnecting.
admin_status_legend_redis_html: Key user:online:{userId}:{deviceId} in Redis. Created on WS connection, refreshed on every Pong. Automatically removed when the connection closes cleanly.
admin_status_legend_ttl_html: Remaining lifetime of the Redis key. The key expires after 90s without a refresh. Green = healthy, yellow = expiring soon, red = <20s (connection probably dead).
admin_status_legend_anomalies_html:
Redis ✓ but WS -: connection closed (e.g. forced app stop) but the Redis key hasn't expired yet. Will disappear within ≤30s.
WS ✓ but Redis -: active connection but presence never written (gateway bug) or TTL expired without refresh.

profile_correction_last_refused: Your last correction request was refused.
profile_correction_help: Tell us what is wrong (campus, programme, class year, posts). An administrator will answer.
profile_correction_placeholder: For example: I am in ISMIN, class of 2026
profile_corrections_load_error: The requests could not be loaded.
profile_corrections_refuse_help: The person will read your explanation in their notifications.
notif_profile_correction_refused_text: Your profile correction request was refused.
audience_err_creator_campus_required: Your profile has no campus: complete it before creating an association or a list.
audience_err_everyone_institution_only: Only an institution may address everyone; an association or a list addresses a campus.
audience_err_admin_or_bde_required: Only an administrator or the BDE can change the audience.
audience_err_institution_admin_only: Only an administrator changes the audience of an institution.
audience_err_outside_bde_campus: The BDE only manages the associations and lists of its own campus.
audience_profile_prompt_body: The audience of an association or a list is computed from your campus, and your profile has none. Request a profile correction, then come back here.
audience_intro: The audience decides who sees its posts and events. A change applies to everything, past posts included.
audience_preset_formations_desc: Only the formations you tick, on that campus.
audience_preset_everyone_desc: Every campus and every formation (institutions only).
audience_preset_custom_desc: Any union of campuses and formations you tick (administrators only).
audience_custom_required: Tick at least one campus or formation.
audience_current_custom: The current audience is custom (set in the spaces grid). Choosing one of the settings above replaces it.
audience_current_unknown: The current audience cannot be shown here; saving replaces it.
audience_save_error: The audience could not be saved.
bookings_refusal_not_manager: You may not manage this space.
bookings_refusal_time_zone: This time zone is not recognised.
bookings_refusal_step_shape: With regular steps, set the length of a step and how many may follow each other.
bookings_refusal_quota_pair: A maximum duration needs a period: per day or per week.
bookings_refusal_export: The export could not be prepared. Update the app and try again.
bookings_refusal_files_pending: Too many files uploaded without a booking for this space: try again tomorrow.
bookings_refusal_files_pending_account: Too many files uploaded without a booking: try again tomorrow.
bookings_refusal_file_not_yours: An attached file is no longer valid: pick it again.
bookings_refusal_questions: A question or an audience criterion is not valid.
bookings_refusal_line: A time range is not valid.
bookings_refusal_closure: A closure ends before it starts.
bookings_refusal_inside_change: Coming bookings ({count}) fall inside this change: cancel them first, then try again.
bookings_tab_subtitle: What people book: a room, an instrument, interviews.
bookings_field_time_zone_hint: The space's hours are read in this zone, for everyone.
bookings_field_private_info_hint: Seen only by a booking's people, while it exists: a door code, a video link.
bookings_mode_step_hint: Each range is cut into steps; a booking takes one or more steps in a row.
bookings_mode_slots_hint: Each range is one slot, booked whole.
bookings_field_max_steps: Steps in a row, at most
bookings_field_audience_hint: Off, any signed-in account may book.

match.daysPlural=one: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 8 MB at most. Readable by the space managers, and deleted {days} day after the slot ends.
match.daysPlural=other: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 8 MB at most. Readable by the space managers, and deleted {days} days after the slot ends.

bookings_builder_file_hint: The person will send a file: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 8 MB at most. It is readable by the space managers and deleted automatically (see Data).
bookings_poster_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Encrypted on this device like a post's image, and saved as soon as it is picked.
bookings_poster_type_error: This image type is not accepted: pick a JPEG, a PNG or a WebP.
bookings_poster_load_error: The poster could not be shown.
bookings_field_retention_hint: Answers and attached files are deleted this many days after the slot ends. A booking itself is deleted one year after its slot ends.
bookings_export_hint: Every booking of the space in a spreadsheet, cancelled ones included. An attached file appears as a word, never by its content.
bookings_field_horizon_hint: How many days ahead one may book.
bookings_field_withdraw: A participant may withdraw until (minutes before)
bookings_field_withdraw_hint: 0: until the start. The holder may always cancel.
bookings_delete_space_hint: Everything goes with it: resources, availability and the booking history.
bookings_delete_space_confirm: Delete "{name}" and all its history? Coming bookings disappear with it, and the people who made them are NOT told: tell them yourself first. This cannot be undone.
bookings_resource_linked_hint: This account sees this resource's bookings and may mark it unavailable: a teacher, a speaker.
bookings_resource_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? A resource that has been booked cannot be deleted: close it instead.
bookings_resource_none: No resource: add one so people can book.
bookings_avail_empty: No range: nothing can be booked.
bookings_avail_problem_empty: The start and the end are the same
bookings_avail_problem_order: The end is before the start
bookings_avail_247_warning: Open all day on consecutive days ({days}): a booking cannot run across the midnight between two whole days. To allow a night, write an evening range that ends the next morning.
bookings_refusal_resource_has_bookings: This resource has been booked before: its history is kept as long as the space exists. Close it instead (remove its hours or add a closure).
bookings_refusal_too_many_spaces: You have reached the maximum number of personal spaces.
bookings_refusal_too_many_resources: This space has reached the maximum number of resources.
bookings_refusal_opens_at: The opening date is not valid.
bookings_refusal_poster_not_yours: This image cannot be used as a poster: choose an image you have just uploaded.
bookings_page_subtitle: Your bookings and the spaces you can book.
bookings_mine_no_notification_note: No notification is sent: a cancellation by the organiser, or a booking you were added to, only shows up here.
bookings_spaces_empty: No space is listed for you. A link-only space opens from its link or QR code.
bookings_personal_subtitle: Slots you offer yourself: interviews, an instrument to lend.
bookings_cancel_confirm: Cancel this booking? The slot becomes free for everyone.
bookings_cancel_confirm_organiser: Cancel this booking? Its people are not told: they will see it when they come back to Bookings.
bookings_withdraw_confirm: Leave this booking? It stays its holder's.
bookings_block_lift_confirm: Lift this unavailability? The slot can be booked again.
bookings_grid_drag_hint: Drag across the grid (long-press on mobile) to pick several slots.
bookings_planning_none: Nothing free in the next {days} days.
bookings_space_qr_intro: Scanning this code opens the space's booking page.
bookings_space_empty_desc: This space has no resource yet.
bookings_space_no_notification_note: No notification is sent: a cancellation or being added is found on Bookings.
bookings_sheet_on_behalf_hint: The booking will be theirs, outside the quotas.
bookings_sheet_holder_missing: Choose the person you are booking for.
bookings_sheet_people_full: The maximum is reached ({max} people, you included).
bookings_sheet_people_note: They are added directly, without being told: they will see it on Bookings and may leave.
bookings_sheet_no_edit_note: A booking cannot be edited: to change an answer or the people, cancel and book again - the slot may be taken in between.
bookings_sheet_personal_note: This is a personal space: if its owner deletes their account, the upcoming bookings disappear without warning.
bookings_detail_organiser_cancel_note: If you cancel it, its people are not told.
bookings_refusal_audience: This space is not open to your profile.
bookings_refusal_slot_range: This period is too long to show.
bookings_refusal_holder_is_participant: The holder cannot also be a participant.
bookings_refusal_space_changed: This space's questions just changed: read them again and retry.
bookings_refusal_too_many_people: Too many people for this booking.
bookings_refusal_too_many_steps: This booking is longer than allowed.
bookings_refusal_notice: This slot starts too soon to be booked.
bookings_refusal_beyond_horizon: This slot is too far ahead to be booked.
bookings_refusal_participant_blocked: One of the people added cannot be.
bookings_refusal_active_bookings: A person of the booking has reached the maximum of upcoming bookings.
bookings_refusal_minutes_per_period: A person of the booking has reached their maximum time for the period.
bookings_refusal_slot_taken: Someone else just booked this slot.
bookings_refusal_try_again: The booking did not go through, try again.
bookings_refusal_history_frozen: It has already started or ended: history can no longer be changed.
bookings_refusal_not_a_participant: You are not part of this booking.
bookings_refusal_withdrawal_delay: It is too late to leave this booking.
bookings_refusal_inside_block: Upcoming bookings ({count}) fall inside this unavailability: cancel them first, then retry.
bookings_refusal_block_overlap: This range is already marked unavailable (in whole or in part).
bookings_stranded_hint: Cancel the ones that must go, then save again. The people concerned are not notified: tell them yourself.
bookings_stranded_more: And {count} more, named once these are cancelled.
bookings_stranded_cancel_confirm: Cancel the booking of {when}? Its holder is not notified.
bookings_stranded_cleared: Nothing is in the way any more: save again.
bookings_unsaved_leave: Some changes are not saved. Leave anyway?
bookings_sheet_window_note: By this device's clock this range cannot be booked now; the server decides when you send it.
bookings_sheet_outcome_unknown: The answer did not arrive, so the booking may or may not have been made. The grid and your bookings were read again: check them before trying again.
bookings_block_outcome_unknown: The answer did not arrive, so the block may or may not have been made. The grid was read again and shows whether it exists: check it before blocking again.
live_viewer_broadcaster_away: The live is interrupted, it should resume.
live_viewer_full_body: Too many people are watching lives right now. Try again in a moment.
live_report_done: Thank you, your report was sent to the moderation team.
live_report_gone: This live is already over, so it can no longer be reported.
live_report_failed: Could not send the report. Try again.
live_report_block_prompt: Also block the person who is broadcasting? You will no longer see their lives, and they will no longer find or invite you. They are not told about it.
live_rule_audience_member: Visible like a post: to the members who share a space with you, and only while it is on air. Nothing of it is kept after the end.
live_rule_audience_association: Visible like a post of the association: to the members it reaches, and only while it is on air. Nothing of it is kept after the end.
live_rule_moderation: Viewers can report a live, and moderation can cut it at any time.
live_rule_duration: {minutes} minutes at most: the live stops by itself at that limit.
live_rule_background: Leaving the app pauses the camera; come back within {seconds} seconds for the live to go on.
live_rules_intro: To accept before your first live, and again whenever they change. They are the same rules as for posts (section 5 of the terms of use):
live_rules_no_sexual: Do not share sexually explicit or pornographic content.
live_rules_no_malware: Do not spread malware or fraudulent links.
live_rules_sanction: Breaking these rules can lead to the suspension or deletion of your account.
live_rules_no_harassment: Do not harass, threaten or intimidate other users.
live_rules_no_illegal: Do not broadcast illegal, hateful or discriminatory content, or content that infringes someone's privacy.
live_start_rules_not_accepted: The live rules changed: read and accept them to start.
live_battery_warning: Battery at {percent}%: a live uses a lot (about 40% an hour, even plugged in).
live_limits_offline: No connection: the live's rules could not be read.
live_limits_failed: The live's rules could not be read.
live_start_muted: Your account can neither publish nor broadcast for now.
live_start_already_open: An earlier live is still open; it closes by itself within the minute. Try again then.
live_start_association_forbidden: You cannot broadcast on behalf of this association.
live_start_rate_limited: Too many lives started this hour. Try again later.
live_start_offline: No connection: the live did not start.
live_end_confirm: End the live? It disappears for every viewer.
live_away_body: Viewers see a gap. The live resumes as soon as the camera is back.
live_away_unsendable: What the camera records could not be sent. Resume the camera; if it happens again, end the live.
live_ended_broadcaster: You ended the live. Nothing of it is kept.
live_ended_server: The live was stopped: it reached its longest duration.
live_ended_server_away: The live stopped while the camera was paused.
live_ended_failed: The live stopped: the server refused the rest of the broadcast.
live_ended_connection_lost: The live stopped: the connection was lost for too long for the broadcast to resume.
live_ended_upload_too_slow: The live stopped: the connection sends more slowly than the camera records, so viewers fell too far behind.
live_ending_waiting: Sending the last seconds… You may leave: the live will stop by itself.
live_viewer_cut_title: This live was stopped by moderators
live_broadcast_cut_title: Your live was stopped by moderators
notif_live_cut_text: Your live was stopped by moderators
notif_live_suspended_text: Your right to start a live is suspended after another cut by moderators
notif_live_withdrawn_text: Moderators have withdrawn your right to start a live
moderation_live_gone_hint: Nothing is left to watch or cut: only the broadcaster can still be restricted.
moderation_live_cut_confirm_body: {name}'s live will be stopped for every viewer, and {name} will be told.
moderation_live_cut_already: This live had already been cut.
moderation_live_cut_forbidden: You are not allowed to cut a live.
moderation_live_cut_not_found: This live no longer exists: there is nothing left to cut.
moderation_live_cut_invalid: The server refused the reason or the details.
moderation_live_cut_error: The live could not be cut. Try again.
moderation_live_standing_due: The withdrawal is due: the decision is yours.
moderation_live_withdraw_body: {name} will no longer be able to start a live, and will be told.
moderation_live_withdraw_done: The right to broadcast was withdrawn.
moderation_live_withdraw_already: The right to broadcast had already been withdrawn.
moderation_live_withdraw_forbidden: You are not allowed to withdraw the right to broadcast.
moderation_live_withdraw_not_due: Not enough cuts are on record to withdraw the right yet.
moderation_live_withdraw_account_invalid: The server does not recognise this account.
moderation_live_withdraw_invalid: The server refused the reason or the details.
moderation_live_withdraw_error: The right could not be withdrawn. Try again.
live_chat_failed_too_fast: Slow down: wait a few seconds.
live_chat_failed_removed: You were removed from this live.
live_chat_failed_unreadable: The others cannot read this message.
live_chat_report_done: Thank you, the message was sent to the moderation team.
live_chat_report_gone: This message can no longer be reported.
live_chat_report_failed: Could not send the report. Try again.
live_start_suspended: You can no longer start a live until {date}.
live_start_suspended_no_date: You can no longer start a live for now.
live_start_withdrawn: The right to broadcast was withdrawn from your account.
notif_live_suspended_text: You can no longer broadcast for a while
notif_live_withdrawn_text: Your right to broadcast was withdrawn
live_chat_report_mismatch: This message cannot be reported: it was changed or is no longer available.
live_chat_report_too_long: This message is too long to be reported.
live_chat_report_unavailable: Reports of messages are unavailable for now. Try again later.
